title: 第27章 韩小汐，我是正常男人

第27章 韩小汐，我是正常男人-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》

门内。

沈珩三两步将人抱到自己床上。

没管她。

任由韩小汐跟裹着自己的大羽绒服打架，笨拙地扯了半天，才露出脸。

“嘿嘿~没关住我~我赢了~”她以为沈珩在跟她做游戏。

傻气。

沈珩闷笑。

这才走过去，蹲下身，帮她——脱鞋。

韩小汐坐在床边上，晃荡着脚丫子，已经脱好的一只脚踢到了男人胸口。

“别乱动！”沈珩的声音带着压制不住的隐忍，三两下帮女孩脱掉另外一只鞋，直接拎着两只脚丫子丢在床上。

动作甚至有些粗鲁。

酒品差成这样，也敢跟男人出去喝酒！

他收走床上两件外套，把人按进被窝里。

“给我老实点，睡觉！”

“不要！”韩小汐拉住男人的手，不松：“你凶我……”

大眼睛无辜地眨巴着，没眨巴两下，眼泪居然就这么流出来了。

沈珩闭眼，又睁开：“韩小汐，我是谁？”

小姑娘缩在被窝里，眼泪忘了流，似乎在很认真的思考。

“你是好人啊！”随即还送了沈珩一个招牌眯眼笑。

沈珩一拳闷闷的砸在被子上。

“我是正常男人。”

说着，头也不回地转身往外走。

只是还没走到房门，砰——

一声闷响。

扭头。

小女人居然从床上掉下来了。

沈珩扶额，看着小姑娘跟被子卷在一起的狼狈样子，闷笑出声。

抬脚重新走回床边。

“抱……”小姑娘坐在地毯上，伸着手臂，求抱抱。

“欠你的。”沈珩蹲下身，单膝点地，将人捞起来。

“不可以丢下我！”韩小汐皱着眉，小脑袋似是想到了什么，毫无征兆地，在男人再次放她上床的时候，在男人唇上吧唧了一下。

“盖章了！是我的了！”随即很满足地咂巴了一下嘴。

沈珩却因为小女人突如其来的偷袭，被狠狠硬控了数秒。

最终叹息了一口气。

靠在床头，哄着小姑娘：“睡吧，我在这儿陪你。”

声音温柔得不像样子。

“不走。”

“嗯。”

“抱抱。”

“好。”

韩小汐好久没睡得这么舒服了。

inside the door.

Shen Heng carried the person to his bed in a few steps.

Ignore her.

Han Xiaoxi was left to fight with the big down jacket that was wrapped around her, tugging awkwardly for a long time before revealing her face.

"Hehe~ You didn't lock me up~ I won~" She thought Shen Heng was playing a game with her.

foolish.

Shen Heng smiled sullenly.

Then he walked over, squatted down, and helped her take off her shoes.

Han Xiaoxi sat on the edge of the bed, dangling her feet, and kicked the man's chest with her already taken off foot.

"Don't move!" Shen Heng's voice was filled with uncontrollable forbearance. He helped the girl take off her other shoe and threw her two feet directly on the bed.

The action is even a little rough.

How dare you go out drinking with a man when your wine quality is so bad!

He took away the two coats on the bed and pushed the person into bed.

"Be patient and sleep!"

"No!" Han Xiaoxi held the man's hand and refused to let go: "You are cruel to me..."

The big eyes blinked innocently, and without blinking twice, tears actually flowed out.

Shen Heng closed his eyes and opened them again: "Han Xiaoxi, who am I?"

The little girl huddled in bed, forgetting to shed tears, and seemed to be thinking very seriously.

"You are a good person!" He then gave Shen Heng his signature squinting smile.

Shen Heng punched the quilt dullly.

"I'm a normal man."

With that said, he turned around and walked out without looking back.

But before I even reached the door, bang——

There was a muffled sound.

Turn around.

The little woman actually fell off the bed.

Shen Heng held his forehead and looked at the embarrassed look of the little girl rolled up with the quilt, and laughed out loud.

He lifted his feet and walked back to the bed.

"Hug..." The little girl sat on the carpet, stretched out her arms, and asked for a hug.

"I owe you." Shen Heng knelt down, put one knee on the ground, and picked the person up.

"Don't leave me!" Han Xiaoxi frowned, something seemed to come to her mind, and without any warning, when the man put her on the bed again, she clicked on the man's lips.

"It's stamped! It's mine!" Then he smacked his lips with satisfaction.

However, Shen Heng was restrained for several seconds because of the little woman's sudden sneak attack.

Finally sighed.

He leaned against the bed and coaxed the little girl: "Go to sleep, I'll be here with you."

The voice was too gentle to look like.

"Not leaving."

"Yeah."

"Hug."

"Okay."

Han Xiaoxi hadn't slept so comfortably for a long time.
